results.title: Raksha Bandhan Gift? UP Government Announces Free Bus Rides and Heightened Security for Women
results.description: The free travel period will run from 6:00 AM on August 27 until midnight on August 29. Female passengers, accompanied by one companion, can travel without charge on buses operated by the Uttar Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation (UPSRTC).

results.title: Iran Warns Vessels Violating Hormuz Protocols Will Be Blacklisted
results.description: The Persian Gulf Strait Authority warned that vessels violating Iranian protocols for transit through the Strait of Hormuz will face restrictions on future passages, PGSA said in a series of statements on X.
